radiology_report:
Jeroen Bosch Ziekenhuis ('s-Hertogenbosch) | Radiology Department | 18 January 2025
Study: Multiparametric MRI Prostate

Clinical indication:
Assessment of a PSA value of 5.5 ng/mL and a prior PI-RADS 5 designation.

FINDINGS:
The glandular tissue occupies a total volume of 40.54 mL. T2-weighted sequences highlight a discrete, posterior, mid-gland abnormality situated in the left peripheral zone, measuring roughly 18 mm across its longest axis. Margins appear indistinct, and the typical zonal boundaries are disrupted. Restricted diffusion is evident on DWI, accompanied by correspondingly low ADC values that point toward elevated cellular density. Post-contrast dynamic sequences capture an early, localized arterial blush within the focus. There is no evidence of seminal vesicle penetration or capsular breach. Pelvic nodes retain normal size and structure.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 5 lesion in the left peripheral zone, posterior mid-gland.
Prostate volume 40.54 mL; PSA density 0.136 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa predicted probability 0.84802127.

previous_notes.text: Clinical records from mid-2023 through early 2024 document a PSA trajectory that climbed from 1.8 ng/mL in July 2023 to 2.6 ng/mL by January 2024. Laboratory trends were formally logged and the patient was informed that serial monitoring would continue to track progression.
